rationale: Retain one global Recurrent Energy platform while correcting its current and former ownership history. Canadian Solar has owned all ordinary shares since March 30, 2015. BlackRock's Global Renewable Power Fund IV invested US$500 million through GRP IV Rose Bidco in 2024 preferred shares representing 20% on a fully diluted as-converted basis at closing. Sharp, Hudson Clean Energy Partners and Mohr Davidow Ventures are former owners; projects and country subsidiaries remain inside the platform boundary. No later platform sale, redemption, conversion, exit or signed pending ownership transaction was identified through August 19, 2026.

beforeImage.name: Recurrent Energy
beforeImage.description: Recurrent Energy develops, owns, and operates utility-scale solar and energy storage projects on a global basis. Its counterparties include utilities, corporate off-takers, and other long-term buyers of renewable-power output and capacity. The business is asset-heavy and contracted because value is tied to owned project portfolios, development pipelines, and long-term power sales. Company materials in 2026 referenced approximately 12 GW of solar projects and 6.2 GWh of storage completed, with a much larger solar and storage development pipeline. Its operating footprint includes the United States and Canada as well as international markets. BlackRock committed $500 million to the company in 2024 through a convertible investment that, on closing, represented 20% of Recurrent Energy's fully diluted shares, while Canadian Solar stated that it retained majority ownership.

afterImage.name: Recurrent Energy
afterImage.description: Recurrent Energy is Canadian Solar's global utility-scale solar and energy-storage development, ownership, operations and maintenance platform. The business develops and selectively retains contracted projects, sells projects and power to utilities and corporate off-takers, and provides long-term operations services across the United States, Canada and international markets. At March 31, 2026, Canadian Solar reported a 23.7 GWp solar development pipeline, an 80.6 GWh battery-storage pipeline and 15 GW of operations and maintenance scope for Recurrent Energy. Canadian Solar has held 100% of ordinary shares since its March 30, 2015 acquisition from Sharp. BlackRock Global Renewable Power Fund IV invested US$500 million through GRP IV Rose Bidco in 2024 preferred shares representing 20% on a fully diluted as-converted basis at closing. No later platform ownership transfer or signed pending exit was identified through August 19, 2026.
